mentions.name: Gusco
mentions.description: Gusco is a file manager that can run in the terminal as a Bubble Tea TUI or as a native-yet-texty app via Gio UI. It recently added an audio player, aimed at fellow file hoarders.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Still building the file manager I've always wanted: https://intestinate.com/gusco/

Added an audio player this past month for all fellow file hoarders out there.

Also, you can now choose if you want Gusco to live in your terminal or run as a native-yet-texty app.
mentions.author: gusco

mentions.name: Gusco
mentions.description: A terminal user interface (TUI) file manager written in Go with Bitwarden, SFTP, and S3 support that runs pretty much anywhere. A built-in audio player is currently in development, aimed at people who purchase and organize their music in files and directories.
mentions.problem: People who purchase and organize music in files and directories lack a worthy competitor to Cubic Player.
mentions.source_excerpt:
TUI file manager with Bitwarden/SFTP/S3 support written in go.

Runs pretty much anywhere.

Current feature in the works is built-in audio player.

As someone who still likes to purchase and organize music in files and directories, I couldn't resist the itch to code a worthy competitor to Cubic Player :)
mentions.author: gusco
